# Seat drift (wm_ideo_monthly_effect): monthly chance (%) that a seat converts to its MP's ideology, and to the
# national poll leader's. Faster when public trust is low (under 30, then under 15) or the seat is rioting.
wm_ideo_seat_drift_mp_chance_value = {
	value = 1
	add = { value = wm_ideo_seat_unrest_value }
}
wm_ideo_seat_drift_national_chance_value = {
	value = 0.2
	add = {
		value = wm_ideo_seat_unrest_value
		divide = 2
	}
}
# Scope: a seat. Extra drift from distrust and riots.
wm_ideo_seat_unrest_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_public_trust
			global_var:wm_public_trust < 30
		}
		add = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = wm_public_trust
			global_var:wm_public_trust < 15
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_county_modifier = wm_riot_county_modifier }
		add = 3
	}
}
